evidence: p932 'Die 11: S. Martini Turonensis': 'Off. lect. H Iste confessor ut ad Vesperas'; 'Laudes H Martine par apostolis (LHym 466)'. No 'Alia melodia'/'Vel' rubric at Lauds. Held option 1 gregobase:9111 (Iste confessor, mode 2) is printed on the page at Off. lect. (and Vespers), not at Lauds; index row #174 codes it 'L V', disagreeing with the page. Martine par apostolis (gregobase:4026, mode 8) is the only hymn the page prints at Lauds. Both index rows carry 'LHym 466', so the index-only-second-melody rule does not apply (different texts).
question: OCO index #174 'Iste confessor' (11/11, coded L V) holds Lauds option 1 for martin-of-tours as gregobase:9111, but p932 prints Iste confessor at Off. lect. ('ut ad Vesperas') and only 'Martine par apostolis (LHym 466)' at Lauds. Recommended: do NOT add Martine as Lauds option 2; instead treat Martine (gregobase:4026) as the Lauds hymn (option 1) and move/drop Iste confessor from Lauds (keep it at Off. lect. and Vespers).
